subject: POC scope rebaseline - additional use cases & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Grant <alicia.grant@acmecorp.com>; Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today

Thanks for the time today - really appreciated the thoughtful discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned before we draft a formal POC plan:

- Use cases discussed: 1) customer support triage (priority), 2) internal knowledge search (secondary)
- Success criteria you called out: 90% accurate ticket routing for top-5 categories; sub-second median latencies on seeded queries; no PII leakage in outputs
- Timeline: 4-week POC with weekly checkpoints
- Ownership: Alicia (Acme) - product lead; Daniel (Acme) - infra; Marissa (Redwood) - overall program owner; Camila (Redwood) - solutions engineer lead

Can you confirm those bullets and any missing evaluation criteria? I'll draft a milestone plan and get Ben to scope the infra/ingest work.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Grant <alicia.grant@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today

Thanks Marissa - that all looks right. A couple of clarifications from our side before you send the plan:

1) Can we add a third use case to the POC: automated reply suggestions (we expect this to help reduce average handle time). It's lower priority than triage but would be valuable to validate.
2) For success metrics, can we split accuracy into Precision@Top1 for routing (>=88%) and False Positive rate (<=5%) for suggested replies?
3) On data: we can share a redacted sample of 10k tickets and a sandbox cluster for the POC ingest. Will that be sufficient for model evaluation?

If adding the reply-suggestion use case changes the timeline, please call that out in the plan. Otherwise proceed and we'll review the milestones.

-Alicia
Alicia Grant | Head of Product, AcmeCorp
alicia.grant@acmecorp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Grant <alicia.grant@acmecorp.com>; Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com; ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: POC plan v2 (proposal) - includes reply-suggestion use case

Alicia - thanks, really useful clarifications. Attached is a proposed rebaseline for the POC that includes the reply-suggestion use case and the split success metrics you requested. High level:

- Scope: triage (top-5 categories), internal search, automated reply suggestions (lightweight generation with recommended confidence thresholds)
- Success criteria: Precision@Top1 (routing) >= 88%; False positive rate for reply suggestions <= 5%; median query latency <= 800ms on seeded tests
- Data: Acme to provide 10k redacted tickets + sandbox Postgres for ingest. Redwood to provide ingest scripts + validation report
- Timeline (updated): Week 0: onboarding & access (1 week) - we start ingest; Week 1-2: model tuning & run evaluation; Week 3: integration + user validation; Week 4: final evaluation & handoff. Note: adding reply suggestions requires an extra 3 business days for evaluation and QA; overall 4-week plan still feasible if we overlap tuning and integration work as noted
- Owners: Marissa (program), Camila (solutions eng), Ben (infra/ingest), Alicia (Acme product), Daniel (Acme infra)
- Deliverables: milestone doc (attached), weekly checkpoints (Wed mornings), final evaluation dashboard (Redwood-hosted link)

Attachments: ACME_POC_milestones_v2.xlsx (milestones + test matrix)

Please review - if this looks good I'll update the SOW and schedule the onboarding session for next Monday.

Best,
Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com; camila.reyes@redwood.com
Cc: Alicia Grant <alicia.grant@acmecorp.com>; Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@acmecorp.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC plan v2 (proposal) - infra notes and data checklist

Looping in technical notes so Acme has visibility before onboarding:

- Ingest: sample size of 10k is fine for initial eval; recommend partitioned sampling for categories to ensure top-5 categories are represented (I'll share a sampling script).
- Sandbox access: please provision a read-only IAM user for our ingest runner and a test S3 bucket (or provide URL).
- Logging & audit: we'll enable request-level logging to a customer-only bucket; see attached for minimal evidence items we'll need for SOC/compliance (logging_and_data_access_notes.pdf)
- Latency testing: will use a seeded query set of ~500 queries to measure median/95p; plan to run from Redwood-hosted infra in us-west region to match expected production latencies

I'll plan to kick off the ingest as soon as the IAM creds and sample files are available.

Ben

From: Alicia Grant <alicia.grant@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@acmecorp.com>; camila.reyes@redwood.com; ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC plan v2 (proposal) - includes reply-suggestion use case

Thanks Marissa - plan looks good to us. A few quick notes:

- We'll provision the sandbox cluster and the read-only IAM user by EOD Tuesday.
- Daniel will share the redacted ticket sample (10k) via the Drive link you shared.
- Confirming the acceptance criteria: Precision@Top1 >=88%; False Positive <=5%; median latency <=800ms. If any of these shift materially during the trial we'll expect a remediation plan and a quick sync with our product team.

Please go ahead and update the SOW and schedule the onboarding for Monday (Mar 8). Looking forward to working with your team.

Best,
Alicia
